audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagrees three ways: packet chart is [Skill, Skill, Aatrox, Skill, Skill, Aatrox, Gangplank]; content win[] has Aatrox at index 3; full phases[] has Gangplank at index 5 (First item).
audit.why: whys[3] itself says the second keg point is 'evening a lane', which is Skill, not Aatrox. whys[5] says his first-item spike plus heal-on-hit out-sustains your Sheen-keg burst, which is Aatrox, not Gangplank. Packet chart matches the text on both rows.
audit.corrected: Align both layers to the packet: Levels 4-5 = Skill, First item = Aatrox. Proposed as one atomic chart group (sides, ratings and the affected why).

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes are described without the real cooldown anchors; the first-item row credits Gangplank when Aatrox's first item plus heal-on-damage wins that window.
audit.why: Aatrox's spikes are The Darkin Blade rank-ups (14/12/10/8/6s), level 6 World Ender (120/100/80s) and first item. Gangplank's are level 2-3 keg chaining, Sheen first item and the 2+ item keg chain. Cannon Barrage is 160s at rank 1 and is a denial/global tool, not a duel win button — the mirror audit states the same.
audit.corrected: First item belongs to Aatrox; 2+ items is where chained keg detonations into empowered Parrrley burst him faster than Deathbringer Stance and Umbral Dash can heal, from outside Infernal Chains' 825 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer names only The Darkin Blade; Infernal Chains, Umbral Dash, Deathbringer Stance and World Ender never appear. dosFull[2].d is also a copy of the 'great trade' line and says nothing about the cleanse it is titled after.
audit.why: The decisive interactions are: Remove Scurvy (W, 22/20/18/16/14s) cures crowd control, so it wipes the Infernal Chains slow and the drag-back; the third Darkin Blade cast only knocks up on its outer edge, so standing inside the swing removes it; Umbral Dash (9/8/7/6/5s) passively heals him on champion damage, which is what makes Grievous Wounds mandatory; Deathbringer Stance is an auto-attack reset, so his wind-up — not his cast — is the step-back cue.
audit.corrected: State the Remove Scurvy vs Infernal Chains answer, the inner-vs-outer Q3 sweetspot rule, the Umbral Dash/Deathbringer Stance healing that anti-heal targets, and World Ender's 120s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns lists generic 'your committal tool' filler and no numbers.
audit.why: Real windows: The Darkin Blade 14s at rank 1, Infernal Chains 20s at rank 1, Cannon Barrage 160s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with the three real cooldowns.

audit.why: Itemization already calls for Oblivion Orb / Executioner's early, which is exactly what the needs-antiheal interaction demands.

edits.after: Poke with kegs, Remove Scurvy his Infernal Chains, scale. Fight while The Darkin Blade is down.

notes: Both packet suspectNames are false positives: 'Remove Scurvy' and 'Powder Kegs' are correct (W and E). The existing early-game claim that Remove Scurvy cannot cleanse an airborne knockup is not verifiable from the kit files, so I left that sentence untouched — logged in unverified.
